en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Najeeh, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem for the one in Ihraam to wear the ring’.
And in another report, (He<sup>asws</sup> said): ‘He should not wear it for the adornment’.
